target: Native workout product landing and internal beta entry

contract.purpose: Explain Setline as a device-first iPhone player for executing an already-authored workout one set at a time.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Setline runs a written workout one set at a time and measures each exercise against its authored target.
contract.audience: A person following a structured strength, cardio, or mobility programme during a real session.
contract.job: Show authored order, current-set focus, explicit deviations, rest evidence, device-first behavior, and honest beta availability.
contract.thesis: The gym is the wrong place to decide; write the session first, then preserve what actually happened without turning Setline into a coach.
contract.system: Light training-instrument landing with real iPhone screens, neon-lime execution cues, explicit fit boundaries, privacy, beta status, project strip, and Ask AI footer.
contract.signature: The current-set player dominates the opening frame while authored, adjusted, and actual values remain visibly distinct.
contract.risk: Avoid coaching, medical, verified multi-device sync, public download, and permanent pricing claims.

answers.product: A device-first iPhone workout player for running an already-written strength, cardio, or mobility programme.
answers.audience: Someone who follows a structured programme and wants less decision-making between sets.
answers.value: It keeps the current set and rest timing obvious while preserving the difference between the plan and what happened.
answers.mechanism: Today resolves authored order, the player records actuals and explicit deviations, and History keeps completed-session evidence.
answers.proof: The page uses real native product screens and names the Today, Player, Rest, Plan, and History surfaces.
answers.nextAction: Inspect the real app screens or read the honest internal TestFlight status.
